title: Information Literacy: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A, AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B

parts.text: Discuss five types of literacy associated with information literacy.
Describe five qualities of an information literate person according to Delphi study.
Discuss five techniques adopted by libraries in carrying out information literacy to its users.
Discuss five methods of disseminating information in academic libraries in Kenya.
Describe five roles of a reference librarian.
Describe five problems encountered during evaluation of information services and systems in most libraries in Kenya.
Discuss five factors to consider when planning a current awareness services evaluation.
Discuss five reasons for evaluating information resources.
Discuss the criteria followed in the evaluation of references sources.
